notes.title: [Steam Next Fest] Full Demo-version release
notes.notes:
[h1]Hi everyone![/h1]

[h2]We have released a demo version of our game Chained Backrooms, so far the game has implemented many game mechanics:

[list]
[*] Physical Chain
[*] Multiplayer
[*] Infinite Gameplay
[*] Procedural Generation
[*] Voice Chat
[*] Character Upgrade System
[*] and more
[/list][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493047/3a7079947ddbbc99695dcfc9d465164eb50adf8c.png[/img]

[h2]We also want to let you know that we will be taking an active part in Next Fest, which will take place from 9 to 16 June[/h2]

[h3]This is a great opportunity given to us by Steam to introduce the game to a wider audience.

At this point, the game is almost out of beta and we are ready to release a demo of our game.

Many thanks to our [b]BETA-TESTERS[/b] who have been testing our game for a month and finding various bugs! Thanks to them we fixed a lot of bugs and now the game is much better!

Our [b]FREE demo[/b] will be released soon, stay tuned for its release!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493047/85f1d3c8a724ed4aff2d74d497ca1241cc70f649.png[/img]

To keep up to date with all the news about the development of the game, visit our [url=https://discord.com/invite/8bJqp3XJ54]Discord server![/url] There you will have the opportunity to chat with the developers and other players![/h3]
